units.phase: fraction of its own lane cycle

similarityMethod: Four-lane Jaccard of exact event positions over pairwise LCM; timing only; not a listening score

presets.name: BERLIN BUNKER · Bass Wall
presets.character: Driving / Hypnotic · an unwavering four-on-the-floor hard kick against rolling offbeat sub-rumble, a 16th-grid hat motor and alternating low-level rim pickups.
presets.mathNote: The kick repeats R₄(1) every bar. The other three circles span two bars: R₈(−1) rumble, R₁₆(−1) hats, and R₄(−1) rim. Individual first-degree roots introduce controlled syncopations; no second step sequencer is used.

presets.name: Concrete · Raw Underground
presets.character: Raw Underground · dry hard quarter-note kick, clipped backbeat claps, coarse offbeat hats and short growling Reese bass stabs. Two-bar ghost variations maintain drive without a Berlin-style rumble wall.
presets.mathNote: R₄(1) is a separate one-bar quarter-kick circle; over two bars R₄(−1) claps land on beats 2 and 4, R₈(−1) hats articulate eighth-note offbeats, and R₃(i) bass sets up a shifting 3:4 polymetric counter-rhythm. Nine degree-one roots add intentionally soft ghost pickups.

presets.name: Polyrhythm · 5 : 7
presets.character: Five equally spaced tom hits oppose seven rim hits; hats give an eight-pulse reference and the kick marks the cycle start.
presets.mathNote: The first two tracks construct a 5:7 polyrhythm from R₅(1) and R₇(1). Only their cycle-start events coincide.

presets.name: Industrial Fracture
presets.character: Dry broken-pressure impacts against metal clicks and a slow detuned bass contour.
presets.mathNote: 5:7:11 polyrhythm in the first three lanes, supported by a shifted nine-root bass contour.

presets.name: Acid Reactor
presets.character: Three anchor kicks, agitated hard-acid response and scattered metallic shrapnel.
presets.mathNote: Relatively prime 3:5:7:11 periodicities with displaced phases.

presets.name: Rotterdam Collision
presets.character: Four relentless gabber pulses clash with seven metallic spikes and eleven noisy accents.
presets.mathNote: 4:7:11:3 exact-root collision study, with offset root families.

presets.name: Schranz Machinery
presets.character: Mechanistic distorted kick punctuated by inharmonic percussive metallic events.
presets.mathNote: Odd-meter 7:9:11:13 layers, with substantial drift between collisions.

presets.name: Broken Reactor
presets.character: Five-beat broken low-end structure under thin snare splinters and screaming acid.
presets.mathNote: Five against eleven against seven against thirteen, with asymmetrical offsets.

presets.name: Frenchcore Spiral
presets.character: Pitched frenchcore kick with seven hard-acid notes and metallic syncopation.
presets.mathNote: 4:7:5:11 with pitched root families and near-aligned source cycles.

presets.name: Acid Singularity
presets.character: Narrow techno foundation against two contrasting resonant acid patches.
presets.mathNote: Prime periods 7:11:13:5 with separately shifted arguments.

presets.name: Prime Number Riot
presets.character: Three robust gabber accents chase five metal beats and a terse melodic rave stab.
presets.mathNote: 3:5:7:11 — all prime root degrees, unlike the related Acid Reactor arrangement.

presets.name: Eleven Against Seven
presets.character: Sparse heavy low-frequency events and rapidly shifting light FM patterns.
presets.mathNote: Seven against eleven is the foreground relation; five and thirteen form a subdued counter-layer.

presets.name: Mechanical Paradox
presets.character: Rotating machinery pulses and destabilized metallic accents.
presets.mathNote: 9:13:7:11, with nonzero phases to avoid universal downbeat collisions.

presets.name: Terror Geometry
presets.character: Fast low-end impacts and densely shifting high-frequency shards, peak-controlled.
presets.mathNote: 4:7:9:13 four-lane polyrhythm: a fixed four-root kick against independently offset seven, nine and thirteen-root layers.

presets.name: Complex Roots Overload
presets.character: Intentionally dense prime-degree texture, with reduced per-lane gain for clarity.
presets.mathNote: 7:11:13:17 – four individually uniform but collectively intricate time sets.

presets.name: Hardtek Möbius
presets.character: Hardtek bounce, pitched kick contour and short saturated acid responses.
presets.mathNote: 5:7:9:4, with a four-root accompaniment countering the odd cycles.

presets.name: Breakcore Prime Shards
presets.character: Dislocated kick and snare accents interleave with high-rate percussive noise.
presets.mathNote: 7:5:11:3 and independent cyclic offsets, not a conventional 16-step break.

presets.name: Euclidean Fragments
presets.character: Prime pulse layers with a distinct five-out-of-sixteen Euclidean accent line.
presets.mathNote: 7:11:13:5 nth-root base sets plus explicit E(5,16) on the last instrument.
